name: GitHub Copilot cloud agent
summary: Copilot agent on GitHub.com that takes delegated tasks from issues, pull requests or chat, works in a cloud environment and opens a pull request for review.
description: Researches the repository, plans, makes changes on a branch and opens a PR. Supported third-party coding agents can be delegated to through the same PR workflow. The older 'about coding agent' docs URL now redirects to the Copilot on GitHub.com page.
